note: Knowledge checks are a reading check only. A pass on them is not verified practical competence.

knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A wipe-down does not show restoration of porous contents. Quarantine and referral are the correct route.
The record links identity, concern, consent and authority, so that each decision can be traced.

practicalCriteria: The learner quarantines porous items and does not accept a wipe-down as restoration.
The learner links each decision to the owner's consent and the authority for it.
Learner completes the procedure record for the mock case and names the stop-work trigger before any practical step.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed mock decision record for the lesson case
Assessor observation of the simulated scenario, with no real site work or hazardous material
stopWorkCriteria: Porous material is proposed for reinstatement without assessment.
Disposal is proposed without owner consent and a record.
